svg.text: sep 2025 - present
digilians program
egyptian military academy / mcit · new capital, egypt
selected from 40k+ applicants to enroll in the m.sc. at queen's university.
workshops with deloitte (pre-training vs fine-tuning, rag architectures, passive chatbots to active ai agents, etl/elt
for genai, mlops lifecycle), ibm (resume building, networking, star interviews) and dotpy (startup fundamentals,
freelancing); sessions at cairo ict (cyshield) on ai agents and at edex on ai in drones, air defense and defense

data scientist
administrative capital for urban development · new capital, egypt
smart-city iot/gis data cleaning and integration (python, sql/duckdb), documented quality checks with pii masking (law
151/2020), kpi pipeline with variance and root-cause analysis.

learn, google earth engine data).

machine learning engineer
electro pi · new cairo, egypt
designed and shipped 15+ production ml systems (harmful-prompt detector for llms, customer-service chatbot, code-
quality evaluator, medical image analysis, automated eda, automated ml).
semantic search engine (tf-idf, lsi, labse) at 87% map; sentiment pipeline (naive bayes + lstm, nltk) at 93% test
accuracy; zero-code automl and autoeda platforms.
completed 11 specialization tracks (python, eda, ml, dl, cv, nlp, llms, rag, prompt engineering, langchain).

huawei ict academy · egypt
